description_en: Creates a cross-service whitelist template for a user
description_zh: 创建用户跨产品白名单模板
kebab_example: aliyun das create-security-ip-group --region-name cn-beijing --global-ig-name test_123 --gip-list 192.168.0.1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSecurityIPGroup

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IP whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

Contains only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

Starts with a letter and ends with a letter or digit.

Is 2 to 120 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

长度为2~120个字符
parameters.name: global_ig_name

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist template.

Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). IP addresses cannot be duplicated. A maximum of 1000 IP addresses are supported
parameters.help_zh:
白名单模板内的IP地址。

多个IP地址需要用英文逗号（,）分隔，不可重复，上限为1000个
parameters.name: gip_list

GlobalSecurityIPGroup.description_zh: 跨产品白名单模板信息

GIpList.description_en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist template.

Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). A maximum of 1000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks can be added across all IP whitelists
GIpList.description_zh:
白名单模板内的IP地址。

多个IP地址需要用英文逗号隔开，所有IP白名单累积支持添加1000个IP地址或地址段

GlobalIgName.description_en:
The name of the IP whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

Contains only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

Starts with a letter and ends with a letter or digit.

Is 2 to 120 characters in length
GlobalIgName.description_zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

长度为2~120个字符

GlobalSecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the IP whitelist template

The region ID.
